plays.name: Google Forms switcher pages
plays.oneLiner: Capture Google Forms switchers with three fair comparison pages and a free-plan path.
plays.audience: Google Forms users searching alternatives on Google; prioritize freelancers and small agencies.
plays.trigger: Need branded links, partial answers, or question-level drop-off.
plays.hook: Google Forms covers basics; switch when branded links, partial answers, or question-level drop-off matter.
plays.mechanic: Comparison page → free signup → paid conversion.
plays.assetUsed: Formkit comparison table and unlimited free tier (confirmed fact 0).
funnel: Three pages × L/M/H 50/150/500 visits monthly [catalog estimate,D]; signup 1/3/5% (D; 8.43% [eesel.ai,C]); paid 2/5/10% (D).
plays.biggestUnknown: Will qualified search traffic convert free users into paid customers?
plays.test: Publish three pages; test for 90 days or 500 visits; $0 media; track upgrades.
plays.killIf: After 500 visits, signup rate below 1%; pause page expansion.
plays.scaleIf: At 5% signups and one paid upgrade per 500 visits, publish six pages.
plays.firstActionToday: Turn Formkit’s current Google Forms comparison into a dated, source-checked draft.
plays.climbosCanDo: Draft page variants, track visits and upgrades, and flag claims for owner review.

plays.name: Assistant-built forms for agency clients
plays.oneLiner: Reach agencies with an assistant-built form workflow; earn referrals to Formkit’s free and paid plans.
plays.audience: Small web and design agencies listed on Clutch; target owners via published business emails.
plays.trigger: An agency takes on a client needing intake or enquiry forms.
plays.hook: Show clients how to create and publish intake forms directly inside Claude or ChatGPT.
plays.mechanic: Agency prospecting → partner calls → client referrals.
plays.assetUsed: Claude/ChatGPT form publishing and unlimited free tier (confirmed facts 0, 3).
funnel: 1,800 sent; L/M/H replies 1/2/3% [instantly.ai,B], booked 20/30/40% [ClimbOS,B], active partners 10/20/30% (D), paid referrals 1/2/3 (D).
plays.biggestUnknown: Will agencies refer active clients, not just like the AI workflow?
plays.test: Send 500 Clutch agency emails in four weeks; $0 media; track replies, calls, paid referrals.
plays.killIf: After 500 sends, replies below 1% or no booked call; stop this audience.
plays.scaleIf: At 3% replies and one booked call after 500 sends, scale to 250 weekly.
plays.firstActionToday: Approve 25 Clutch agency targets and a short form-building demo.
plays.climbosCanDo: Find and send 150 approved, personalized agency emails weekly; stop follow-ups on reply.

plays.name: Assistant marketplace listing
plays.oneLiner: Test whether Formkit’s Claude workflow can acquire users through an assistant marketplace listing.
plays.audience: Claude Marketplace users exploring form tools; the marketplace lists 2,000+ connectors and plugins.
plays.trigger: Users want to create or publish forms without leaving Claude.
plays.hook: Create and publish a Formkit form inside Claude or ChatGPT; start on the free plan.
plays.mechanic: Assistant marketplace listing → tracked free-plan signup.
plays.assetUsed: Claude/ChatGPT form creation and publishing (confirmed fact 3).
funnel: Listing approval L/M/H 10/25/40% (D); views 100/300/1,000 (D); signup 1/3/5% (D); paid 2/5/10% (D).
plays.biggestUnknown: Is Formkit eligible, and will a listing send paid users?
plays.test: Verify eligibility and submit one listing; test 90 days; $0 spend, no paid placement.
plays.killIf: If listing eligibility fails or no paid account arrives by day 90, stop.
plays.scaleIf: At three attributed paid customers, test ChatGPT and workflow directories.

plays.climbosCanDo: Check two assistant-directory routes weekly and draft listing copy and tracking links.
